nodes.description: Address of the wrapped original ERC20 token; target of external transfer/transferFrom calls.
Public token name string set once in the constructor.
Public token symbol string set once in the constructor.
Token decimals, hardcoded to 8.
Internal total supply of proxy tokens, mutated by deposit/withdraw.
Scaling factor (100000000) applied to deposited/withdrawn amounts.
Mapping of account balances; written in deposit, withdraw, transfer, transferFrom.
Nested allowance mapping; written by approve, approveAndCall, transferFrom and permit.
Per-owner permit nonces, incremented inside permit.
Immutable uint max constant, declared but unused.
EIP-712 domain typehash used to build the permit digest.
EIP-712 permit struct typehash used in permit.
Constructor initializing name, symbol and _originalToken.
Internal deposit routine: pulls original tokens via transferFrom and mints proxy balances.
Public burn routine: reduces balances then externally transfers original tokens back to msg.sender.
Payable fallback that unconditionally reverts, blocking plain Ether transfers.
Read-only balance lookup for a token owner.
Read-only total supply getter.
Sets allowance[msg.sender][ext] to amt and emits Approval.
Moves proxy balances from msg.sender to a recipient.
Moves balances on behalf of from while decrementing the caller's allowance.
Approves a spender then performs an arbitrary external call into it via receiveApproval.
Callback entry that validates the token address and forwards to depositTokens.
EIP-2612-style permit using ecrecover, nonces and a deadline based on block.timestamp.
Internal helper returning chainid via inline assembly.
msg.sender: attacker-controlled caller used as allowance owner, balance source and transfer origin.
block.timestamp: miner-influenceable time value compared against the permit deadline.
External call ERC20(_originalToken).transferFrom(from, address(this), amount) in depositTokens.
External call ERC20(_originalToken).transfer(from, amount) executed after state mutation in withdrawTokens.
Arbitrary external call ApproveAndCallFallBack(spender).receiveApproval(...) with user-supplied spender and data.
Balance/supply arithmetic (amount * supplyFactor, balance subtraction) used across deposit, withdraw, transfer and transferFrom.
ecrecover(digest, v, r, s) signature recovery inside permit.
tokenName parameter of the constructor.
tokenSymbol parameter of the constructor.
mutatingToken parameter assigned to _originalToken.
from parameter of depositTokens, the source of original tokens.
amount parameter of depositTokens, multiplied by supplyFactor.
amount parameter of withdrawTokens, burned and released.
tokenOwner parameter of balanceOf.
ext spender parameter of approve.
amt value parameter of approve.
to recipient parameter of transfer.
tokens amount parameter of transfer.
from parameter of transferFrom.
to parameter of transferFrom.
tokens amount parameter of transferFrom.
spender parameter of approveAndCall, used as the external call target.
tokens allowance value parameter of approveAndCall.
arbitrary data parameter forwarded to the external receiveApproval call.
from parameter of receiveApproval forwarded into depositTokens.
tokens amount parameter of receiveApproval.
token address parameter of receiveApproval, checked against _originalToken.
data parameter of receiveApproval.
owner parameter of permit, must equal the recovered signatory.
spender parameter of permit receiving the allowance.
rawAmount allowance value parameter of permit.
deadline parameter of permit compared with block.timestamp.
v recovery byte parameter of permit.
r signature half parameter of permit.
s signature half parameter of permit.
Local from = msg.sender in withdrawTokens.
Local from = msg.sender in transfer.
Computed EIP-712 domain separator local in permit.
Computed permit struct hash local in permit.
Final EIP-712 digest local fed to ecrecover in permit.
Recovered signer address local in permit, checked against owner.
Assembly-assigned chainId local in getChainId.

edges.reason: Constructor parameter mutatingToken is written into the _originalToken state variable.
Constructor parameter tokenName initializes the name state variable.
Constructor parameter tokenSymbol initializes the symbol state variable.
depositTokens 'from' parameter drives the balance credit and external transfer source.
depositTokens 'amount' parameter is the value being deposited.
Deposit amount multiplied by supplyFactor is credited into balances[from].
supplyFactor scales amounts before they are written into the balances mapping.
withdrawTokens 'amount' parameter drives the burn and external release.
msg.sender is assigned to the local from in withdrawTokens.
Local from indexes the balances mapping that gets decremented on withdraw.
msg.sender determines whose balance is burned in withdrawTokens.
balanceOf tokenOwner parameter indexes the balances mapping.
approve ext parameter becomes the inner key of allowance[msg.sender][ext].
approve amt parameter is stored as the allowance value.
msg.sender is the outer key of the allowance mapping in approve.
transfer 'to' parameter receives the moved balance.
transfer 'tokens' parameter is the moved amount.
msg.sender is captured into the local from in transfer.
Local from indexes the balances mapping debited by transfer.
transferFrom 'from' parameter is the debited account.
transferFrom 'to' parameter is the credited account.
transferFrom 'tokens' parameter is the moved amount.
msg.sender indexes the allowance that transferFrom decrements.
User-supplied spender becomes the external call target in approveAndCall.
User-supplied tokens is forwarded to the external receiveApproval call.
User-supplied data is forwarded unchecked to the external receiveApproval call.
permit v parameter is passed to ecrecover.
permit r parameter is passed to ecrecover.
permit s parameter is passed to ecrecover.
ecrecover result is assigned to the signatory local.
permit owner parameter is used both in the struct hash and the authorization check.
permit spender parameter is hashed and later granted the allowance.
permit rawAmount parameter is hashed and stored as the allowance value.
deadline is a user-supplied time value compared against block.timestamp, creating timestamp/expiry dependency.
block.timestamp is read in permit to validate the deadline signature expiry.
nonces[owner] is read and incremented while building the permit struct hash.
DOMAIN_TYPEHASH is used to compute the domain separator in permit.
PERMIT_TYPEHASH is used to compute the permit struct hash.
The recovered signatory gate precedes writing allowance[owner][spender] in permit.
rawAmount is written into the allowance mapping at the end of permit.
owner parameter indexes the allowance mapping written by permit.
receiveApproval 'from' is forwarded into depositTokens.
receiveApproval 'tokens' becomes the deposited amount.
receiveApproval 'token' is validated against _originalToken.
receiveApproval 'data' is accepted from the untrusted caller.
_originalToken is compared with the caller-supplied token argument in receiveApproval.
balances mapping is read by balanceOf.
_totalSupply is returned by totalSupply.
depositTokens performs the external ERC20 transferFrom call.
withdrawTokens performs the external ERC20 transfer call.
approveAndCall invokes the external receiveApproval callback on the spender.
receiveApproval delegates the actual deposit logic to depositTokens.
permit calls ecrecover to validate the signature.
permit calls getChainId to build the domain separator.
approve writes the allowance mapping.
transfer writes the balances mapping.
transferFrom writes the balances mapping.
depositTokens performs amount * supplyFactor balance and supply arithmetic.
withdrawTokens performs balance and total supply subtraction arithmetic.
transfer performs balance addition/subtraction arithmetic.
transferFrom performs balance and allowance subtraction arithmetic.
External call into spender can invoke receiveApproval on this contract, which mutates balances and supply.
Arbitrary external call target can reenter approveAndCall before allowance state settles.
External call into the untrusted original token can reenter depositTokens during balance/supply updates.
External transfer into the untrusted original token occurs after state mutation in withdrawTokens and can reenter.
